title: Remove game export history from git to reduce clone size
description:
Game exports in website/public/games/ have been committed and re-exported many times, so git history contains hundreds of MB of old versions of these JSON files. Even after the v6 migration drops llmTrace (~420 MB from the working tree), the old versions remain in git objects.

Use BFG Repo-Cleaner or git filter-repo to rewrite history for website/public/games/*.json and *.json.gz, keeping only the current versions. This is a one-time destructive operation that requires force-pushing and all contributors to re-clone.

Prerequisites:
- v6 migration should be completed first (so we don't rewrite history twice)
- Coordinate timing with Gregor since all clones become stale
- Consider doing this alongside or after the move-game-exports-out-of-git effort
